meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你是科研人员，想远程运行蛋白质或核酸相关的生物实验。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage biological experiments on an automated cloud lab.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a scientist who wants to run protein/RNA experiments without stepping into the lab.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你挑选并配置 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上的实验协议(如蛋白表达纯化、定量、RNA 合成等),准备输入模板、查价格与周期,并提交下单。
howto.when: 当你提到 Ginkgo Cloud Lab,或想做蛋白表达纯化、HiBiT/A280 定量、IVT mRNA/circRNA 合成等实验时,它会接管协议选择与下单流程。

say.text: 帮我跑一个 cell-free HiBiT 表达定量,价格和周期是多少?
say.note: 会给出该协议价格、周期与下单步骤

say.text: 我要做 IVT mRNA 合成 + qPCR,输入模板怎么准备?
say.note: 会说明需要上传的输入文件格式

say.text: 帮我下单一张荧光像素画的板。
say.note: 会提示该协议为 Beta 及价格

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude helps you pick, configure, and submit Ginkgo Cloud Lab protocols (protein expression, quantification, RNA synthesis and more), prepare input templates, and check pricing and turnaround before ordering.
howto.when_en: Use when you mention Ginkgo Cloud Lab or want protein expression and purification, HiBiT/A280 quantification, or IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis; Claude then handles protocol selection and ordering.

say_en.text: Run cell-free HiBiT expression and quantification — price and turnaround?
say_en.note: Gives price, turnaround and ordering steps

say_en.text: I want IVT mRNA synthesis plus qPCR; how do I prepare the input template?
say_en.note: Explains the required input file format

say_en.text: Order a fluorescent pixel art plate for me.
say_en.note: Notes this protocol is Beta, with pricing
